reviews.title: Has become annoying to use
reviews.text: Please for the love of everything turn off (or allow us to turn off by default) the workout length or at least display intelligence when we've stopped. I can never remember to close the workout out and constantly go back to a workout that is literal hours!!!

reviews.title: Update fail
reviews.text: I been using this app for 10 months now and love it but yesterday you updated it now it won’t let me use the timer or save my routine today, I have deleted the app and put it back on and still won’t work can you have a look at it

reviews.title: Devs don’t care
reviews.text: The app itself and the idea is good. But the UI is absolutely awful. The keyboard is appearing / disappearing for no reason at all. The autocorrect doesn’t work. You can’t scroll through workouts without the app going bonkers and deciding it’s just gonna scroll for you. Devs keep asking for feedback but when you ask about some stuff they say “it’ll be fixed in the next few weeks” but 2 months later there are no updates / patches / fixes at all and the devs are ignoring every attempt for communication. I used the app for more than 6 months and was waiting patiently to see if there are ANY improvements but devs obviously can’t be bothered to put it any work so I’m deleting this and not coming back. Also this is not just my impression, people online been saying they’ve been asking for stuff for 2+ years and have been also ignored. So….. good job devs. I applaud you 👏
